## Accessibility release gate (all ecosystem user-facing changes)

Record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED and evidence; do not merge while a required check is untested or failing without maintainer-approved documented exception.

- [ ] Keyboard and switch-access paths, logical focus/reading order, visible focus
- [ ] Screen reader: desktop and iPad Safari/VoiceOver (when UI affected)
- [ ] WCAG 2.2 AA text/control/focus contrast, 200% zoom and responsive reflow
- [ ] Form errors and instructions, touch targets, non-color-only state cues
- [ ] Reduced motion, media alternatives, interruption and cancellation/recovery
- [ ] Desktop and iPad/mobile preview URLs and results recorded
- [ ] Shared site-wide CSS used; no new per-page style duplication
